mapper.sql:
a.*, g.name as goodsName, g.img as goodsImg, g.price as originalPrice, g.description as goodsDescription, case when now() < a.start_time then '未开始' when now() > a.end_time then '已结束' else '进行中' end as state,
(select count(*) from seckill_record r left join orders o on o.id = r.order_id where r.activity_id = a.id and (r.order_id is null or o.status != '已取消')) as sold
mapper.select:
select
from seckill_activity a left join goods g on g.id = a.goods_id order by a.id desc

select
from seckill_activity a left join goods g on g.id = a.goods_id where a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into seckill_activity (goods_id, seckill_price, stock, start_time, end_time, status) values (#{goodsId}, #{seckillPrice}, #{stock}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: update seckill_activity set stock = stock - 1 where id = #{id} and stock > 0
mapper.select: select activity_id from seckill_record where order_id = #{orderId} limit 1
